actions.description: Hand reaches to the hanging pipettes/rack area, then withdraws without a clear liquid-handling step.
Hand grasps a hanging pipette and lifts it off the rack.
Pipette is moved from the rack area toward a yellow tip box on the bench.
Pipette cone is pressed into the yellow tip rack to attach/seat a tip.
Pipette is lifted away from the tip box and moved back toward the rack area.
Pipette is returned to the hanging rack/holder.

reuse.evidence: No aspiration/dispense or transfer between samples/reagents is visible, and no reused tip is shown being used on another medium.

surface.evidence: The tip/cone is only seen contacting the tip rack; no contact with bench, glove, tube exterior, or other non-sterile surface is visible before use.

release.evidence: No tip or pipette is visibly dropped, ejected, or released unexpectedly.

install.evidence: Tip attachment appears to be done by pressing the pipette into the tip rack; no visibly wrong-size or poorly seated tip is apparent.

output.overall_summary: The visible clip shows selecting a pipette, attaching/seating a tip from a tip rack, and returning the pipette to the rack. No visible pipetting technique error is evident in the sampled frames.
